key_insight: SCP combines market microstructure features with self-supervised, clipped-objective reinforcement learning to improve risk-aware portfolio allocation.
engineering_relevance: For quantitative trading systems, the framework targets sensitivity to intraday market dynamics and more stable policy learning.
method: Integrate tick-level microstructure patterns with macro-level financial indicators.
Construct intermediate asset-state representations for portfolio allocation.
Optimize allocations using a self-supervised, clipped-objective policy learner.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved risk–return trade-offs over state-of-the-art baselines on three major Chinese A-share index datasets, with exploratory and ablation studies supporting component contributions.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish live-trading robustness or performance after transaction costs and slippage.
paper_title: Self-supervised Clipped-objective Reinforcement Leaning Framework for Risk-aware Portfolio Management
